name: Consulting Storyline Deck
description: Build an executive presentation around a clear decision. Each slide states a conclusion, supports it with focused evidence, and advances a coherent business case in a distinctive teal-and-amber visual system.
whatYouGet: An action-title storyline from problem to decision
Charts and comparisons with source or assumption notes
A closing slide with a concrete approval request
goodFit: Fundraising narratives grounded in operating evidence
notFor: Exact reproduction of a corporate template

faq.q: Can I provide rough notes instead of a finished outline?
faq.a: Yes. The skill organizes the notes into a decision-led storyline and flags evidence gaps or assumptions that need confirmation.

faq.q: Will it calculate a business case?
faq.a: It can calculate from figures you provide and show the assumptions. It will not invent verified results or imply that illustrative figures are actuals.

faq.q: Can I export the deck to PDF?
faq.a: The HTML deck is designed for 16:9 presentation and print-to-PDF output without external assets.

demoPrompt: /sl-consulting-storyline-deck Create a 9-slide board deck for Fictional Software Company, moving from the automation decision and 38-day/22% baseline to a phased-vs-full-replacement comparison, pilot gates, value tests, risks, and approval. Title: “A phased onboarding upgrade can shorten time to value.” Close: “Approve the pilot and require evidence before a scale decision.” Keep it crisp and evidence-led in Verdict Margin style.
followUpPrompts: Make the recommendation legible from the slide titles alone.
Add a sensitivity view for the savings estimate.
Tighten the deck for a ten-minute executive discussion.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
